news.title: Join our Discord!
news.subtitle: Stay up to date with Nythera
news.body: Join the official ApexVision Studio Discord server to get support, report bugs, suggest features, and chat with the community and the developers directly.

news.title: Welcome to Nythera
news.subtitle: Thanks for using the client
news.body: We're always working on new features and improvements. Keep an eye on the Changelog panel for the latest updates, and let us know what you'd like to see next!

news.title: Found a bug?
news.subtitle: Help us improve
news.body: If something isn't working right, please report it in our Discord's support channel with as much detail as possible so we can fix it quickly.
